mission.title: Swallow Your Pride
mission.description: Take Veil's intercepted transmissions to the Machines for decryption, then raid one of her hideouts.

npc.say: There's some pretty weird stuff on there; we haven't been able to make anything of it. Hope you'll have better luck!
All right, we'll see what we can do. Glad to see you've come to us for help, {player}.

phase.briefing:
Ah, there you are, Warrior. It's been too long since I've worked with you.
As it turns out, Veil was a busy little bee during the last few weeks of her imprisonment. Somehow, she managed to get communications going in and out of her cell in Zion. Ask yourself how she did that, and the answer must be traitors. I know, it's unbelievable.
Anyhow, we happened to record some of the last transmissions inadvertently. I'm sending you to pick up that recording from Altaj. We have a special task in mind for you.

enter.say: Altaj should be in here. Just grab the recording and we'll find out what Tyndall has in mind.

talk.say: There you are, {player}! Here, grab this recording.

done.say: That's it. Now head on out of there.

phase.briefing:
Wonderful. Now on to your meeting... with the Machines.
I think we're going to have to trust them this once. Their decryption programs are unparalleled. If we really want to get Veil back, I think we're going to have to open up our counsels to them.
Oh, and before you head in there, you should know... they're aware of Anome's little device. He really is too cocky for his own good. We've cleaned things up with them, so don't worry... but in the future, don't be so eager to do everything he asks, okay?

enter.say: Okay, Aiguillon should be in here somewhere. Find him and hand over the recording... and hope he doesn't bust your chops over that whole Anome deal...

talk.say: So, {player}. Looks like you need our help, huh? Hand over the recording and I'll get our people on it.

done.say: That wasn't too bad. I think that's it for this mission; go ahead and head out of there.

phase.briefing:
Well, I guess we just need to wait and see-- Hold on! I'm getting an urgent message from Agent Gray...
Well, that was quick. They've generated two possible locations that Veil may be trying to use right now!
I've sent the crew of the Nescire to one of the sites; you get to the other one! There's no time to waste!

enter.say: I'm reading a lot of hostiles in there, {player}. I think they're all bunched up in there... your top priority in this mission is finding Veil. We have to find her so we can figure out where her hovercraft is broadcasting from.
There they are, the masked bastards! Get through there somehow and nab Veil... she must be through the far doors!

objective.text: Hack the computer beyond the far doors

done.say: Damn it! No Veil... I hope the other crew is having more luck! You'd better get out of there.

mission.finish: I'm sad to say this, Warrior, but the crew of the Nescire didn't have any more luck than you. They apparently didn't have any contact, just some traces of masked activity... we're going to have to do better next time.
